subject: Closure reprofiling & stakeholder commitments — proposed MAP revision
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@northstarhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-10-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Closure reprofiling & stakeholder commitments — proposed MAP revision

Tom —

Quick note after this morning's sync: I understand procurement has an internal freeze from 11/01–11/10 which will push your approval window out a couple of weeks. That creates risk for our originally-targeted 11/15 close.

I attached a short reprofiling of the MAP that shifts the formal close to 11/29 while preserving your evaluation milestones (trial completion, latency/regression checks, SOC2 evidence review). Key asks from our side:
- Confirm new target close = 2027-11-29
- Prioritize SOC2 evidence review by 11/12 so legal/procurement have the artifacts before their freeze
- One-week extension on trial access for your QA team (we can extend capacity at current committed throughput)

I'm attaching MAP_v2_NorthStar.xlsx and a pared-down evaluation plan. If you prefer, we can lock the new date conditionally and open a short canary for production on 12/06 — keeps you live sooner if procurement clears early.

Next steps: please confirm stakeholders (names + decision owners) and whether procurement needs a separate SOW or PO language.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
mobile: +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: MAP_v2_NorthStar.xlsx (spreadsheet), EvaluationPlan_NorthStar.pdf (PDF)

From: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@northstarhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@northstarhealth.com>, procurement@northstarhealth.com, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-10-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Closure reprofiling & stakeholder commitments — proposed MAP revision

Karthik —

Appreciate the proactive reprofile. Three quick datapoints from my side:
1) Procurement freeze is company-wide 11/01–11/08 (not 11/10) — slight correction. We expect approvals to resume week of 11/09.
2) Legal will need the SOC2 artifact and a redline of the SLA by 11/05 to not block the resume of approvals.
3) Our QA lead (Elena) asked for an additional end‑to‑end test window of 7 business days after the trial cut-off. That likely pushes the earliest meaningful go/no-go to 11/22.

So 11/29 seems reasonable but I'd like us to commit to an interim checkpoint the week of 11/15 to avoid surprises. Can you commit to updating the MAP to reflect: revised legal review dates, a 7-business-day QA extension, and an explicit contingency if SOC2 review raises questions?

Also please confirm whether the extended trial will require any config changes (region, throughput) — we need a heads-up for our cloud cost forecasting.

Thanks — Tom
VP Product, NorthStar Health

Date: 2027-10-22T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Closure reprofiling & stakeholder commitments — proposed MAP revision

Tom —

Thanks — agree to the interim 11/15 checkpoint. I've updated MAP_v2 to include:
- Legal review requested by 11/05 (SLA redline attached in tab 'SLA')
- QA extension of 7 business days after trial cut-off (trial cut-off moved to 11/15; QA window 11/16–11/24)
- Contingency: if SOC2 review raises issues, we move to conditional close with a vendor-corrective action plan and a 2-week remediation hold; open fallback is to a reduced-throughput pilot so you can ship lower-risk features.

Extended trial: no config changes required for the additional week — we will absorb the incremental cost for that period under the current commercial terms. If you need higher concurrency beyond the existing profile, let us know 48 hrs before the QA window starts.

I'll drop the updated files to the shared Drive and send a one-page risk log to the procurement thread.

—K

Attachments: MAP_v2_NorthStar.xlsx (updated)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-10-25T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: NorthStar — risk log snapshot (for 11/15 checkpoint)

Team —

Posting a short risk log ahead of the 11/15 checkpoint. Highlights:
- Risk #1: Procurement freeze mismatch — mitigated by earlier legal deliverable (owner: Karthik)
- Risk #2: SOC2 artifact incompleteness — mitigation: SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf pushed to external on 10/26 (owner: Neha)
- Risk #3: Trial QA failure leads to >2-week slip — mitigation: extended QA window, on-call engineering for hotfixes during 11/16–11/24 (owner: Monica)

I'll maintain this log and update severity/status columns after the 11/15 checkpoint. Attaching the initial risk log as part of our internal record.

Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf

Date: 2027-10-26T09:07:00-07:00

Adding a quick note for escalation path: if legal flags SOC2 evidentiary gaps after 11/05 review, we need preapproved language for a 14-day remediation window and a one-time credit concession. Can we get sign-off from Finance on a $15k credit cap ahead of time? I'm looping in Finance in a separate thread today; wanted to call this out so Sales has the option ready.

Neha
Head of Security & Compliance Operations, Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-11-03T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Finalized reprofiling and confirmed close target: 2027-11-29

Tom / Elena / Procurement —

Following our internal check-ins and Neha's confirmation on SOC2 artifacts, we are locking the reprofiling into a conditional MAP:
- Target close: 2027-11-29 (conditional on legal sign-off by 11/05 and QA acceptance on 11/24)
- Interim checkpoint: 2027-11-15 10:00 AM PT — 30-minute status call (we'll send calendar invite)
- Contingency: If SOC2 issues arise, we will initiate a 14-day remediation cadence; Redwood agrees to a one-time credit up to $15,000 if remediation materially delays go-live beyond 11/29.
- Trial extension: QA window 11/16–11/24 as discussed; no config changes required unless you request increased concurrency.

Tom — please confirm receipt and whether procurement needs the MAP exported as a PDF for SOW submission. Once you confirm, I'll send the invite and upload the final MAP and evaluation plan to the shared Drive link.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
